# Relative project resolution from an unrelated caller directory.
mkdir caller
cd caller
exec ctx context --bundle ../project --ticket ticket.md
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json true
stdout '"text":"---\\ntype: WorkItem\\ntitle: Café\\n---\\n# Ticket\\n"'
stdout '"kind":"root"'
cmp ../project/ticket.md ../original.md

# A second project is independent of the first.
exec ctx context --bundle ../second --ticket new.md
stdout 'Second project'
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json true

# Missing and unreadable tickets are incomplete JSON, status 1.
exit 1 ctx context --bundle ../project --ticket missing.md
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json false
stdout 'source_missing'
exit 1 ctx context --bundle ../project --ticket .
stdout 'source_unreadable'
exit 1 ctx context --bundle ../project --ticket broken.md
stdout 'invalid_frontmatter'
cp stdout result.json
jsonresult result.json false

# Invalid invocations do not emit JSON and cannot use an environment fallback.
env PROJECT=../project
env TICKET=ticket.md
exit 2 ctx context
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx context --bundle ../project
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx context --bundle '' --ticket ticket.md
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx context --bundle ../absent --ticket ticket.md
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx context --bundle ../project --ticket ticket.md extra
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx context --unknown
! stdout .
exit 2 ctx nonsense
! stdout .

-- project/ticket.md --
---
type: WorkItem
title: Café
---
# Ticket
-- original.md --
---
type: WorkItem
title: Café
---
# Ticket
-- project/broken.md --
---
title: [broken
---
# Still preserved
-- second/new.md --
# Second project
